name: testland/testcontainers
description: Use when integration tests need a real database, message broker or browser (Postgres, Redis, Kafka, Selenium) in a container, or when containerized tests are flaky: a fixed sleep waiting for a service, a container reported ready before it accepts connections, parallel tests sharing one container's data, or network teardown errors. Starts throwaway containers from inside the test process with Testcontainers (Java, Node.js, Python, Go, .NET, Ruby and more), wiring the container lifecycle, mapped host ports, wait strategies (port, log, HTTP, SQL), networks, Ryuk cleanup and the experimental withReuse for local dev.
